name: Black Hole Cat
source:
He possesses greaty upernatural powers, including being a huge asshole!  Everything about him never makes any sense!Well, he's a cat so what did you expect? A food lover, take care though if you offer some of it asking for a favor, cause instead of getting better, things could get even worse!
He will be quite helpful in the game.
Although he is indeed a big asshole, you can’t help but like him too. Since he’s a cat, everybody likes cat… right?
Also, cats never make any sense… So don’t ask us how this cat possesses supernatural powers
